sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000106-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Northstar Urgent Care 106 on March 13, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 1.25%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Influenza share floor of 70%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: countered by the Customer.
